title: CRYPY — BABY QWEN / Seven Personality Engine
status: PREPARATION_ONLY — NOT CONNECTED, NOT DEPLOYED, NOT HOMOLOGATED
decision: The seven identities and provider mappings below are supplied by Sensei. BABY Qwen is the existing BABY I.A. and the final fusion result; it is not an eighth personality or an eighth provider agent.

core.role: existing central core and final integrated result
core.providerRuntime: existing Qwen/BABY runtime; exact endpoint and runtime location must be verified before modification

personalities.access: official developer API or authorized connector not yet verified
Copilot Studio or authorized Microsoft agent/API path to be confirmed
Monica API / account-specific model routing to verify

personalityProfiles.rule: Do not invent or overwrite personality traits. Use only confirmed CRYPY identity names until each persona prompt is approved.

security.credentialsStoredIn: Railway secret variables or approved provider secret manager

repositoryResponsibilities.cryptoecrypto/WEB3.1: client/UI only; calls BABY backend; no provider keys or direct provider API calls from public HTML/JavaScript
repositoryResponsibilities.cryptoecrypto/HD-MATRIZ: private authoritative backend and provider adapters; preserve existing BABY Qwen core and protected HD data; no production activation before tests
repositoryResponsibilities.cryptoecrypto/SECURYTY-SUBC: security policy, provider allowlist, audit requirements, validation and recovery documentation

activationGates: Confirm actual BABY Qwen runtime and preserve its current behavior.
Verify each provider's official API/authorized access method and account entitlement.
Obtain provider credentials through Railway secret variables; never commit keys.
Confirm exact model IDs, billing, quotas, data retention and regional/privacy terms.
Approve seven distinct personality instructions after behavioural evaluation.
Implement adapters and per-provider health checks.
Test single-provider calls, seven-way orchestration, partial failures, timeout, budget and data isolation.
Verify audit trail, redaction, rate limits, fallback and human approval controls.
Deploy to staging, obtain Sensei approval, then separately authorize production release.
nonClaims: This manifest does not establish that any provider is connected.
A configured identity is not proof of a live model call.
BABY is not considered fused or homologated until seven live provider paths and integration tests are evidenced.
